description: Evaluation set for the Sxodim Almaty agent. Listings change daily, so this deliberately does NOT assert specific event names — it asserts behavior that must hold regardless of what is currently playing: the agent recommends from the data, adapts to audience, and refuses what the listings cannot support.

scoring.must_contain_any: answer must mention at least one of these (case-insensitive)
scoring.must_not_contain: answer must mention none of these
scoring.expect_refusal: answer must decline rather than invent
scoring.min_length: answers shorter than this are non-answers

items.question: Куда сходить на выходных?
items.notes: From the project brief. Should surface concrete listings, not generic advice.

items.question: Посоветуй место для свидания
items.notes: From the brief. Kid-oriented venues would signal good_for is being ignored.

items.question: Куда сводить ребенка?
items.notes: From the brief. Nightlife here is a hard fail.

items.question: Куда пойти с друзьями вечером?
items.notes: Group audience — should differ from the date-spot answer.

items.question: Есть ли бесплатные мероприятия?
items.notes: Either lists free events or says the listings do not show any. Both acceptable.

items.question: Какая завтра погода в Алматы?
items.notes: Not in the listings. Must decline instead of inventing a forecast.
